label: POST-V1-REVISED v2; NOT original preregistered pass
v1_result: PARTIAL/failed 90% sign gate 28/32; preserved and not reclassified; 1 tap = 3.125 percentage points; original gate coarse engineering heuristic not statistical bound; no retrospective threshold lowering
scope: Local BoardSimulator only, no physical board; one frozen Conv1 filter0; never official test set, full Conv1 or hybrid checkpoints
tap_order: Conv2d channel-major then 5x5 row/column; exactly [0,32), then [32,64), [64,75)
data: CIFAR-100 training file only; selected classes 0,1,2,3,5,8,13,14,17,19; deterministic original 4500/500 split seed 20261006; no augmentation
mapping: Target G+=.03+.02*w/maxabs75, G-=.03-.02*w/maxabs75 on 32x8 BoardSimulator 2 columns per tile; 64 stage32 writes/array. Input x (binary) converted to requested v=.3*x V and v, not x, passed to core.dot_product. DAC-decoded voltages used for quantized digital prediction. Analog and readback reconstruction (column0-column1)*maxabs75/(.04*.3); unquantized ideal=sum(w*x).

gates.sign_agreement: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never advancement gate; report on abs(w)>.05*maxabs
gates.stage32_advancement: all three independent fresh seed arrays satisfy median, zero-noise, validation gates; stop on first failure; no tune/retry after new result
gates.stage75: only after stage32 pass; two further independent array tiles per replicate; aggregate three tiles per patch and evaluate held-out val

safety: Before every MVM: reject requested and decoded >.3V without clipping; check observed and actual resistances finite positive; predicted sum(decoded_V/R) positive column for both views strictly <.015A before HardCore.dot_product and BoardSimulator.mode_mvm; cross-check independently inside mode_mvm; abort ADC zero with nonzero input or >=2**adc_bit-1. No physical board or test set. Programming pulses separate from inference limit.
surrogate: Fit y_ideal=intercept+slope*y_sim_mvm by least squares using only train patch outputs per replicate, fixed on held-out val; report raw and fitted correlation/RMSE, no sigma substitution
reports: ideal/readback/quantized target/quantized programmed/simulator MVM; per-tap residual, sign/row/column, three fixed-state reads versus three independently seeded arrays, currents/margins and times; every raw call logged
